---
applyTo: "packages/authn/src/**/*"
---
**Disregard human readability concerns.** Humans do not author code in the
`packages/authn/src/` directory; it is owned exclusively by coding agents, but
human-maintained test suites in `packages/authn/test/` provide 100% coverage.

The code should be optimized for the **token efficiency** of future coding
agents.
